title: FBI Photo B010
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale surveillance/targeting display screenshot with overlay
pages.description: A grainy black-and-white display showing a grayscale field with a central white crosshair reticle featuring tick marks and numeric scale markings (15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15) along the horizontal axis. The upper portion of the image is covered by a large black rectangular band. Several black rectangular blocks, appearing to be redactions or obscured regions, are arranged symmetrically on the left and right sides of the frame at multiple vertical levels. Some blocks have adjacent lighter gray patches. In the lower portion of the image, a faint textured dark area resembling terrain or hills is visible. A small dark spot appears near the center-right of the frame. A white timestamp overlay reads in the lower-left corner. The overall texture is noisy, consistent with a low-light or infrared-style sensor image.
